info.name: Chariot FDX Accounts properties API
info.description:
Financial Data Exchange (FDX) v6 compatible API for read-only access to Chariot bank account data. Implements the FDX v6 standard for account information, transactions, and statements.

Contact Support:
 Name: Chariot Development Team
 Email: developers@givechariot.com

request.description:
Appends a Property to one or more Donations or Deposits.
A maximum of 100 resources can be assigned to a property at a time.
The resource identifiers must be of the same resource_type as the Property, otherwise a 400 Bad Request error will be returned.
